scripts.gate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:manifest && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.release:patch: changeset version --type patch && pnpm install && git add -A && git commit -m 'chore: release patch' && pnpm changeset tag
scripts.release:minor: changeset version --type minor && pnpm install && git add -A && git commit -m 'chore: release minor' && pnpm changeset tag
scripts.release:major: changeset version --type major && pnpm install && git add -A && git commit -m 'chore: release major' && pnpm changeset tag
